plan.notes: Source: official 2024-2025 SouthArk catalog. Semester 4 carries an optional PHED 1001 (~1 cr, 'if needed to satisfy the required 2 credit hours of Physical Education'); the catalog's semester 4 total is '15-16' and lower bound is seeded, total_credits = 60.

courses.choice_note: Math Choice (3 cr): MATH 1023 College Algebra, MATH 1033 Plane Trigonometry, MATH 1113 Mathematical Reasoning, or MATH 2015 Calculus I. Credits shown for MATH 1023.
courses.title: College Algebra

courses.choice_note: Choose one: CSCI 1003 Introduction to Computers, a Social Science Choice, or a History Choice. Credits shown for CSCI 1003.
courses.title: Introduction to Computers

courses.choice_note: History Choice (3 cr): HIST 1003 History of Civilization, HIST 1013 History of Civilization Since 1700, HIST 2013 History of US 1876, or HIST 2023 History of US Since 1876. Credits shown for HIST 1003.
courses.title: History of Civilization

courses.choice_note: Fine Arts Choice (3 cr): ENGL 2213 Literature I, ENGL 2223 Literature II, ARTI 2003 Art Appreciation, MUSI 2003 Music Appreciation, THEA 2003 Theatre Appreciation, or PHIL 2003 Introduction to Philosophy. Credits shown for ENGL 2213.
courses.title: Literature I

courses.choice_note: Fine Arts Choice (3 cr) from the same option list. Credits shown for ARTI 2003.
courses.title: Art Appreciation

courses.choice_note: Choose one science with lab (4 cr): a Biological Science Choice (BIOL 1004/L, 1114/L, 1024/L, 1034/L, 2064/L, 2074/L) or a Physical Science Choice (CHEM 1004/L, 1014/L, 1024/L, GEOL 1004/L, 1014/L, PHYS 1004/L). One biological and one physical science are required across semesters 2-3. Credits shown for BIOL 1004/L.
courses.title: Fundamentals of Biology/Lab

courses.choice_note: Social Science Choice (3 cr): PSYC 2003 General Psychology, SOCI 2003 Introduction to Sociology, GEOG 2003 Introduction to Geography, ECON 2003 Macroeconomics Principles, or PSCI 2003 American Government: National. Credits shown for PSYC 2003.
courses.title: General Psychology

courses.choice_note: Choose one: ENGL 2213 Literature I or ENGL 2223 Literature II (if not already taken as a Fine Arts choice in semester 2). Credits shown for ENGL 2213.
courses.title: Literature I

courses.title: History of Civilization Since 1700

courses.choice_note: Choose one: PHED 1001 Physical Education Activity or HPER 1403 Personal and Community Health. Range 1-3; lower bound seeded, credits shown for PHED 1001.
